other_conditions: Must be a native of Puducherry Union Territory or a continuous resident for the past three years
Already trained candidates are not eligible to apply
Application must be submitted directly to the General Manager, District Industries Centre, Pondicherry; applications through any organization or association will not be accepted
Applicant must not be receiving financial assistance from any other source
Age certificate from the appropriate authority is required
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly stipend of Rs.1,500 to trainees along with trainer honorarium and raw‑material compensation for a six‑month training program.
documents_required: Certificate from the District Collector/Dy. Commissioner confirming financial position and that the applicant is not receiving financial assistance from any other source
Age certificate from the appropriate authority
Affidavit before a First class Magistrate (if income/age certificates are not furnished)
